title: Embedded Linux OS Architect
description:
About the team:
Mobileye Autonomous Driving software group is looking for an OS expert with strong knowledge in the Linux Kernel. As a Linux Operating System architect, you will be responsible to work with system and SW architecture teams to define OS solutions to satisfy customer requirements for the autonomous vehicle world. This involves security and connectivity components in Mobileye’s Safety critical Linux OS involving both the Kernel and the user space worlds.
This is an exciting and unique opportunity to work with highly talented Linux OS team and be a leader in the development of the Linux as a platform for the Safety Critical Automotive industry.
What will your job look like:
Defining and designing OS solutions for the security and high-speed connectivity requirements.
Conducting PoC activities to verify architectural decisions and resource allocation involving SW Simulators.
Writing architectural design specification documents, defining KPIs and testing criteria.
Working with the development teams closely to review design and test plan documents.
Performing performance analysis to maximize performance and optimize HW utilization while maintaining the real time behavior.
All you need is:
Strong knowledge in Operating Systems in general and experience with the Linux Kernel specifically.
Proven experience in writing architectural specifications and conducting architectural reviews.
Strong experience in performance analysis and debugging techniques.
Experience with the MIPS & RISCV HW architecture and their implementation in the operating system.
Previous experience in PCIe and Security is a big advantage.

title: Embedded Team Leader -OS Integration & Automation
description:
About the team:
Mobileye is looking for a skilled and motivated Embedded SW Integration Team Lead for the Platform OS Department to manage the daily integration of the OS deliveries into Mobileye’s SW stack. The Platform OS team of Mobileye is leading a global effort of making the Linux OS as the Automotive Safety OS that will fuel the Autonomous Vehicle and the whole automotive industry. You’ll lead a fast-paced, hands-on and dynamic team of integration and automation engineers, contributing to the overall qualification and integration effort of Mobileye while collaborating with other teams across the organization.
What will your job look like:
Lead and mentor a team of 4-6 SW Integration and Automation engineers.
Manage the daily integration of the aggregated delivery of all OS teams upstream into Mobileye’s SW stack.
Daily tracking of changes coming from OS development teams and controlling their integration order, priorities, test coverage and conflicts.
Managing a daily integration forum to track nightly tests reports, triaging new issues found and assigning them to development teams.
System level understanding of the OS features and tracking the test coverage developed by the OS developers.
Tracking the utilization, health and allocation of the HW resources in the farm.
Balancing test coverage to HW availability through tracking CI load.
Acting as a PoC for all OS integration issues. Both within the OS teams and externally.
Tracking bug escapes and their mitigation in the OS test coverage.
All you need is:
B.Sc
. or higher in Computer Engineering or Computer Science.
Prior experience in leadership of a tech lead role.
5+ years of experience in Integration of Embedded SW.
Strong C and Python programming skills.
Strong analytical skills with hands on ability to track and isolate issues.
Experience in Continuous Integration & automation methodologies and tools.
Big advantage for experience with the embedded Linux Kernel development.

title: Testing & Validation Engineer
description:
About the team:
At Mentee Robotics, we are redefining humanoid automation with an AI-first approach - combining perception, reasoning, and dexterous manipulation into fully autonomous systems that continuously learn and adapt.
We are now expanding with a new robotics Engineering center in China, working hand-in-hand with our engineering teams in headquarters. Its mission: to rapidly develop our next-generation full-size humanoid and bring it to life - a walking, working platform that becomes the foundation of our next generation of products. This is a small, senior, hands-on team where speed of iteration is the core value.
We are looking for a Testing & Validation Engineer to own quality across the humanoid program: from joint-level dyno and life testing to full-system benchmarking and shipment readiness before delivery to headquarters. You define what 'done' means - for every component and for the robot.
Who you are?
A test engineer with strong mechatronics intuition - you understand what you are measuring
Structured and data-driven, but pragmatic about what a prototype actually needs
Comfortable being the gatekeeper
Responsibilities:
Build and operate the joint test infrastructure: dyno setups for torque, speed, efficiency, thermal, and life testing of actuator modules
Define and execute component-level verification for boards, batteries, harnesses, and sensors with the responsible engineers
Own integration verification at every stage: leg on bench, robot on gantry, free-standing, walking
Define and run full-system performance benchmarking (payload, speed, endurance, repeatability) and reliability assessment
Build the acceptance criteria and shipment-readiness process for every robot and subsystem delivered to headquarters
Develop test automation (Python) and maintain traceable test records tied to hardware and firmware revisions
Feed structured failure analysis back into design - you close the iteration loop
Requirements:
B.Sc. in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering
5+ years in testing and validation of electromechanical systems: robotics, automotive, or automation
Hands-on experience building test rigs and instrumentation (torque sensors, current probes, thermal measurement, data acquisition)
Strong data analysis skills; Python proficiency for test automation and reporting
Experience in defining verification plans, acceptance criteria, and reliability/life test programs
Fluent English for cross-site collaboration with headquarters
Advantages:
Experience at humanoid/robot companies, cobot firms, or automotive
Actuator/servo dyno testing experience
Familiarity with HIL testing and firmware validation
Exposure to safety and compliance standards for robotics

title: Junior Design Emulation/Validation Engineer m/f/d
description:
Junior Design Emulation/Validation Engineer m/f/d
Ra'anana, Israel
Change the world. Love your job.
We are looking for somone to join our WiFi hardware team.
Our team operates in an AI-driven environment where we leverage cutting-edge AI tools to enhance productivity, code quality, and reduce development timelines. You'll be expected to actively utilize and promote AI-assisted development practices within the team.
What you'll do:
In this role, you will work on defining, developing and debugging validation environments for TI’s wireless MCU products targeted at Industrial markets. You'll Deep dive into both low level and system level modules, ensure compliance with specifications, collaborate with experienced software, Architecture, design and verification teams and build your skills through hands-on projects and dedicated mentorship.
Requirements
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical / communication Engineering, or equivalent
Hands-on technical experience in either HW or SW fields
Basic knowledge in C programming
Team Player, collaboration and interpersonal communication skills
Demonstrated independent learning ability, initiative, and proactive thinking
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to details
Ability to work in a team both local and global. Strong communication skill – Verbal and written
Advantages
Experience with electronic components, test equipment and test setups
Familiarity with coverage-driven testing, object/aspect-oriented programming
Basic experience with AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar tools)
Academic or personal projects demonstrating use of AI tools and prompt engineering
